title: THE PICKED CONTRACT LOOKS PICKED
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): make the menus look like a AAA game, checked in pictures. On the Mainframe the picked contract showed only a thin amber line under it, which read as a divider, and clicking another contract left that line on the first one. The picked contract now has the amber edge and warm fill used on the title, and it moves with your click.
now: The picked contract on the Mainframe has an amber edge that follows your click.
